title.narrative: Integral & Authentic Human Development workshop Bangladesh

description.narrative:
This year the Church will be reflecting again on integral and authentic human development, particularly in the light of the anticipated Encyclical addressing issues of climate, environment, the global economy and poverty; and the planned Synod on the Family. Reflection and debate on development, human flourishing and the impact of poverty is part of a rich tradition in the Church’s Social Teaching, beginning with Populorum Progressio in 1967.
As a Catholic agency it is critical that we engage with this teaching, and indeed contribute insofar as we are able to the development of Catholic Social Thought from practical, theological and theoretical perspectives.
CAFOD has agreed to employ an expert in Catholic Social Teaching and development for a one year period, in order to enable the organisation to reflect on its own understanding of development within this framework and tradition and advance its corporate understanding. The theology programme has been asked to focus for this year on international programmes and support this reflection.
This expert, together with the a CAFOD staff member from the Advocacy team will host the workshop in Bangladesh as part of a wider set of workshops taking place globally to reflect on the meaning and practice of integral and authentic human development in the light of the recent Encyclical.
